tradition.name: Latin hip hop
tradition.lineage: Latin hip hop spans Spanish-language and Latin American rap practices. Ana Tijoux’s Vengo branch explicitly brings Latin American acoustic instruments into a contemporary rap recording.

extras.description: Rhythmic lead rap meets programmed percussion, Peruvian cajón strokes, Andean quena phrases and Colombian gaita melody. The quena is a notched flute and the Colombian gaita a flute, not Galician bagpipes.
